interfaces.gui: no native extension at this seam

state.owner: one cooperating writer per host and configured local directory
state.writer: OS file lock plus checksummed unresolved-reservation journal
state.queues: references only; no migration or writes
state.checkpoint: application-owned durable payload; in-session arbiter cache only

adapters.bach: injected facade only; no live BACH boot or DB import
adapters.inference_gate: native async gate.turn(chat_id, priority, check_ready, model_target)
adapters.pipelines: generic original planner/executor pointers for research, services, media and builds
adapters.host_observer: native read-only memory/disk observations; UTC timestamp; never grants admission
adapters.host_routing: central heavy/recurring preference with platform and headroom checks; proposal only

admission.mode: default closed; explicit offline fixture names or operator-configured pinned reviewed CPU process profiles
admission.metrics: fresh increasing sequence, verified reserve, RAM/CPU and pressure
admission.release: matching generation and execution identity, valid checkpoint, verified exit and zero process residency, newer capacity readback

live_gates: measured system reserve and capacity sensor
external_effects: no network without explicit HostService/HostClient use

observation.catalog: pipeline-catalog.json; reference examples, no live queue registration
observation.system_reserve: explicit caller headroom, no invented universal threshold
observation.cpu: logical cores/load are observations, not authoritative free CPU

focus_controller.loop: explicit tick from the existing host loop; no installed service or polling thread
focus_controller.clients: configured private bearer capabilities with socket, priority and interactive scopes
focus_controller.override: operator-only command bound to host, writer session, request, reason, ID and bounded expiry; replay never renews
focus_controller.handoff: existing facade checkpoint/stop/exit/new-capacity protocol; callbacks outside controller mutex
focus_controller.fairness: bounded interactive slice and protected background runtime after the arbiter chat burst
focus_controller.idle: ends interactive grant without phantom requeue; next native input needs a new request identity
focus_controller.audit: fsynced host-local token-free audit under the existing writer
focus_controller.activation: profile and native adapter gates remain unchanged; no production cutover

host_transport.endpoint: explicit 127.0.0.1 listener; no automatic service install or discovery
host_transport.auth: existing scoped controller clients; private bearer header; host and writer-session fencing
host_transport.limits: 8 HTTP workers, 1 MiB JSON, absolute 2 second input deadline, no proxy/redirect/CORS
host_transport.lifecycle: caller-owned accept loop, one managed poll worker, serialized lifecycle calls and 5 second drain; stop never frees an active torch
host_transport.activation: programmatic optional transport; no native production client cutover

reviewed_profiles.approval: explicit configured profile SHA256, evidence SHA256, native host/platform/architecture, bounded UTC validity; no automatic file discovery
reviewed_profiles.binding: socket allocation and canonical ProcessCommand argv/cwd/source pins/explicit environment fingerprint
reviewed_profiles.evidence: sampled CPU process-tree RSS and cumulative CPU; explicit reviewed concurrency and RAM margin; not a worst-case or kernel limit proof
reviewed_profiles.scope: CPU-owned processes only; external model/GPU residency remains unapproved
reviewed_profiles.revocation: re-read pinned bytes before acquire and execution; checkpoint/stop/exit/release remain available
reviewed_profiles.cli: profiles validates explicit local pins read-only, without starting work
